selection.weights: Equal weight per logged PPO rollout
selection.tie_break: Lowest seed number for equal logged scores
selection.note: Final logged rollout precedes the last PPO gradient update; evaluation uses the final saved checkpoint.

uncertainty.method: Percentile bootstrap of whole episodes independently within each of 22 fixed partner profiles
uncertainty.scope: Conditional on the selected policy and fixed partner profiles; does not include seed-selection uncertainty.
